events.title: Join the Official Discord Server!
events.summary: Hey everyone! After some requests, I have opened up a discord server for DIVEBOMB: Weaponized Racing! You can take part in discussions, provide feedback, ideas about the game or report bugs!See you in the Discord Server!

events.title: Demo Version Alpha 1.42
events.summary: Hey all! A quick fix before Steam Next Fest!Demo Version Alpha 1.42:Fixed an issue that caused flickering shadows on barriers in Lagoon Circuit.Improved NPC behavior performance related to racing lines. Should improve CPU performance slightly.

events.title: Demo Version Alpha 1.41
events.summary: Demo Version Alpha 1.41:Improved soft collision accuracy.Improved performance of soft collisions.Added Hood Camera after many requests.Added loading screen images depending on level being loaded.Decreased elimination time on Lagoon Circuit from 60 seconds to 45 seconds.Changed models of traffic cars wheels.

events.title: Lagoon Circuit Update - Demo Version Alpha 1.4
events.summary: Hey Everyone!I am proud to announce the release of Demo Version alpha 1.4, the Lagoon Circuit Update! The new level Lagoon Circuit is an abandoned race track. Overgrown with wild weeds, asphalt degraded to a point of barely functioning and a pit building barely standing.Aside from the new level, some major performance fixes have been done. Combined with the 1.3 Update, this update should feel much better, especially on CPU limited cases.This will be the last major content addition for the demo,

events.title: Demo Version Alpha 1.25
events.summary: Demo version alpha 1.25:-Fixed an issue that caused extreme collisions against planes and trucks.-Fixed an issue that made Quick Roadblock indestructible.-Changed the camera controller so that, crashes that cause the car to spin fast will trigger the orbit camera making the movement nicer on the eyes.

events.title: Demo Version Alpha 1.23
events.summary: Hello Everyone!After feedback from casual players, the easy difficulties were still difficult for them to enjoy the game. So, I have improved the efficiency of assists in easier difficulties, and added descriptions for difficulty presets so everyone can decide easier, which difficulty is fit for them.Demo Version Alpha 1.23:-Fixed an issue regarding countersteering assistance.-Implemented torque vector braking for "Rookie" and "Pro" difficulties.-Added difficulty explanations for each difficulty

events.title: Demo Version Alpha 1.2:
events.summary: Hello everyone!After feedback from players, the audio mixing have been completely redone. Now all audio in the game has been loudness normalized, mixing has been adjusted for better harmony.Also, a fix trial has been launched for a rare physics stutter issue on certain hardware. If you experience any physics stutter issue please share with me the hardware information and if possible a small video clip at rpmdigitalgames+support@gmail.com. Thank you all for your continued support.Demo Version Alp

events.title: Demo Version Alpha 1.101 is Out!
events.summary: Hello Everyone!After some consideration I have realized that the demo is too large in file size only for a demo. So I have implemented some new compression trickery to shrink the download size of the demo to 2.5GB from 5GB! And the size on disk has now reduced from 8.7GB to 6.5GB!Demo Version alpha 1.101Improved compression to decrease file size.Adjusted suspension on Schattenfelts-XT to decrease oversteer tendency under braking.

events.title: Heavy Traffic Update - Demo Version alpha 1.1
events.summary: Hello Everyone!Thanks a lot for you continued interest in DIVEBOMB:Weaponized Racing. Now that critical fixes are out of the way (at least for now), I bring you the Heavy Traffic Update!Watch out for planes and heavy trucks!Aurora Aerospace is now a fully functioning aerospace port! Walls and other contestants are not the only thing between you and victory. events.summary: Hello everyone!I have updated the Demo, this time mainly for balancing and fixes. You can find the patch notes below. events.title: DEMO VERSION 1.0 IS OUT!
events.summary: Hello everyone!Thanks for all the time on the demo build so far! It is motivating to see you all enjoy and provide feedback for the game! After the UI Overhaul, the majority of the feedback was about the sense of speed and the wacky camera movements. So with the first full early access release of the DEMO, the camera movement is overhauled to provide a more natural feel. You can find the changelogs below! As always keep the feedback coming! I will try my best to make DIVEBOMB: Weaponized Racing

events.title: Version 0.98 - The UI Overhaul
events.summary: Hello everyone!The demo has been out for almost a week now and one thing is certain! The UI was not liked by many. It was called intrusive and hard to read. So I bring you the new overhauled UI. It is designed mostly to be readable and less intrusive while keeping the AR hologram look. I will try to keep up with all the feedback to make DIVEBOMB the best it can be!Thank you all for your support and feedback!Demo Version 0.98 Changelog:NEW:-Overhauled UI with less intrusive and more readable elem

events.title: Demo Version 0.96
events.summary: Hello Everyone!The demo is now officially out! After feedback in the first hours of the demo regarding the distracting nature of the HUD, I have scaled down the Race HUD and UI Bloom intensity. It should feel much less intrusive now!Demo Version 0.96 Patch Notes:-Resized race ui and lowered ui bloom intensity to make the UI less distracting.
